# LangChain Expression Language (LCEL)

:::tip[Prerequisites]
Read the runnable interface guide before this conceptual overview.
:::

LCEL composes runnables declaratively so chains get streaming and batching for free.

<Tabs>
  <TabItem value="py" label="Python">
Use the pipe operator to compose a prompt, a model and an output parser.
  </TabItem>
</Tabs>

```python
chain = prompt | model | parser  # :::tip stays inside code
```
